mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE > 8% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 for three consecutive months signals supply chain weakness, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 98 for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which reduces corporate borrowing costs and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE > 8% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals strengthening demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 rises for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 98 for three consecutive months signals supply chain strength, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 98 for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
